main.bork:22:3: mock can only be used in a test body
main.bork:27:13: Fetch takes 1 parameter (url), but the mock names 2; write: mock Fetch(url)
main.bork:28:8: total is pure, and only functions with effects can be mocked: the compiler relies on a pure function giving the same answer for the same arguments (facts named after it, and predicates calling it, would go stale); test it as it is, or have the code under test take it as a function value
main.bork:29:8: positive is a predicate, and only functions with effects can be mocked: the compiler relies on predicates' answers to prove facts
main.bork:30:8: println is built into the compiler and cannot be mocked; mock the function that calls it
main.bork:31:8: Pick is generic, and generic functions cannot be mocked yet; mock a non-generic function that calls it
main.bork:32:8: cannot mock missing: there is no function named missing
main.bork:33:8: cannot mock time.now: package bork/time has no now
main.bork:34:19: the mock of Fetch must give String, but its body produces Int
main.bork:35:3: Fetch is already mocked in this block (at main.bork:34:3); mock it again in a nested block
main.bork:37:5: mock can only be used in a test body, not in a lambda (which may run later, or on another task)
main.bork:44:16: function Fetch returns String, but this returns Int
main.bork:50:5: mock can only be used in a test body, not in the body of another mock
